steps.sql: DECLARE @j json=N'{"s":"a"}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.s' RETURNING char(3)) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"s":"a"}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.s' RETURNING nchar(3)) AS v;

DECLARE @j json=CAST(N'{"s":"'+REPLICATE(CAST(N'x' AS nvarchar(max)),5000)+N'"}' AS json); SELECT LEN(JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.s' RETURNING nvarchar(max))) AS n,LEN(JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.s' RETURNING nvarchar(4000))) AS narrow;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"s":"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.s' RETURNING varchar) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"a":1}'; SELECT JSON_QUERY(@j WITH ARRAY WRAPPER) AS v;
